{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of channels and customer segments
crosstab = pd.crosstab(df_completed['channel'], df_completed['customer_segment'])
print(crosstab)

# Check conversion rates by channel (raw)
raw_conversion_by_channel = df_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nRaw conversion rates by channel:')
print(raw_conversion_by_channel)"}
